notes: Implemented as an integer-only trapezoidal (TPT) state-variable filter, which is exactly the bilinear Butterworth that scipy designs, with int64 Q32 states and high-precision Q30/Q31/Q42 coefficients via a portable 64x32 multiply; unlike a direct-form biquad (poles ~4e-4 from z=1, DF-II states ~2.5e6x the DC offset) its states stay bounded by the input range, so it is stable over hours and full-scale offsets. Against reference.py on 2-hour test signals (noise, +/-32000 offsets, drift, full-scale steps/square, full-range random) the output matched bit-exactly except a few +/-1 LSB rounding ties (<2e-6 of samples).
